_why: THE REGISTRY OF WHAT MUST BE RUNNING. Created 2026-07-13 after a failure that must never repeat: com.ruvnet.brain-nightly's launchd trigger had NEVER fired, and nothing noticed, because 'is it running?' was only ever answered by looking at a job's own exit code — and launchd reports exit 0 for a job that has never run, which is indistinguishable from success. Silence was being read as health.
_how_it_works: scripts/job-heartbeat.sh wraps every job and writes start/end/exit receipts that a dying job cannot forge or skip (trap-protected). scripts/nightly-watchdog.mjs compares THIS registry against reality: a job listed here that is not loaded, or loaded but has no fresh receipt, or has a receipt with a non-zero exit, is a VIOLATION and gongs the phone. Absence of evidence is failure, never 'probably fine'.
_adding_a_job: Add it here FIRST, then wrap its plist command in job-heartbeat.sh. A job not in this registry is unwatched by definition — that is the whole point of a registry rather than per-job good intentions.

jobs.label: com.ruvnet.goldie-weekly
jobs.what: Re-researches the cheapest/best models and refreshes the router catalog

jobs.label: com.ruvnet.model-refresh
jobs.what: Refreshes the live model list (~/.claude/models.json) that the router prices against

jobs.label: com.stuartkerr.api-spend-watchdog
jobs.what: Hourly guard against runaway API spend and agent bursts — the one that actually pages the phone
jobs._note: It has been pushing '4 scheduled jobs failing silently' every hour, correctly — but off launchctl's exit-code field, which CANNOT see a job that never ran. It alerts; it just can't see the hole. Now it is itself watched: nothing supervised the supervisor.

jobs.label: com.cognitum.ruvector-autoupdate
jobs.what: Every 6h: git pull of ~/RuVector_Clean (the RuVector source the Rust crates build from)
jobs._note: Its git stash pop has silently failed once (orphaned stash@{0} from 2026-06-28 — it swallowed local edits and nothing said so). The heartbeat now catches a non-zero exit; the orphaned stash still needs a human decision.

jobs.label: com.stuartkerr.clear-claude-tmp
jobs.what: Every 3h: purges Claude Code task-output temp files older than 2 days (the dir hits ~800MB)
jobs._was_lying: Its log line had the date BAKED IN at plist-write time — all 43 entries since 2026-04-06 were byte-identical. It worked; its log was a lie. Now a real script with a real $(date) and a real delete count.

jobs.label: com.ruvnet.nightly-watchdog
jobs.what: Watches all of the above. Listed here so that IT is watched too — a watchdog nobody watches is the same blind spot one level up

jobs.label: com.ruvnet.issue-watch
jobs.what: Hourly GitHub-issues SLA watcher (stuinfla/ruvnet-brain): pages once when a person's issue arrives and once if it passes 4h unanswered; one 9 a.m. ET summary of anything still waiting (owner/bot issues never page)

jobs.label: com.ruvnet.issue-fix
jobs.what: Every 30 min: read-only triage of eligible GitHub issues (stuinfla/ruvnet-brain); no code mutation, no worktree creation, no branch push, no public comment, and no promotion. Unattended fixes run only in the separate daily com.ruvnet.issue-autofix job (ADR-107); this job stays read-only.

jobs.label: com.ruvnet.issue-autofix
jobs.what: Daily 10:30 local: fixes every eligible GitHub issue a person filed (stuinfla/ruvnet-brain) that the night's budget allows, each in its own worktree of its own clone, and ships all fixes that pass verification and the security gate as one release through the protected release gates (ADR-107); off unless the repository variable ISSUE_AUTOFIX is exactly on; halts itself after any red once main has moved

jobs.label: com.ruvnet.routing-flywheel
jobs.what: nightly data-readiness DRY-RUN of the routing flywheel (the plist runs --dry-run: reads receipts + prints readiness, runs NO loop and writes NO receipt — honest label per F13 2026-07-18; switch the plist to --synthetic to run a real $0 loop)

jobs.label: com.ruvnet.npx-witness
jobs.what: records every npx-cache mutation to the witness log (pure observer). Event-driven: weeks of silence are NORMAL when nothing touches _npx — maxAgeHours is a 90-day tripwire against the job being unloaded, not a freshness SLA. Registered per F2 2026-07-18: it was loaded+wrapped but absent here, i.e. unwatched by the registry's own definition.

jobs.label: com.ruvnet.ntfy-inbox
jobs.what: Every 15 min: reads the owner's ntfy topic into ~/.cache/ruvnet-brain/ntfy-inbox.jsonl and keeps the open-alert list SessionStart shows (scripts/ntfy-inbox.mjs)

jobs.label: com.stuartkerr.purge-local-snapshots
jobs.what: Hourly: deletes Time Machine LOCAL snapshots on the internal SSD (skips while a backup runs); real backups stay on the external drive (~/Library/Scripts/purge-local-snapshots.sh)
jobs._registered: 2026-10-26 (4.7.21): loaded and wrapped by job-heartbeat.sh but absent here, so it was unwatched by the registry's own definition.

jobs.label: com.stuartkerr.model-freshness-watchdog
jobs.what: Daily 09:10: compares each provider's LIVE model list with the models referenced in Repo-Explainer/.env and flags a newer family (~/.claude/scripts/model-freshness-watchdog.sh)
jobs._registered: 2026-10-26 (4.7.21): loaded and wrapped by job-heartbeat.sh but absent here.

_retired.label: com.ruvnet.brain-nightly
_retired.why: It ran author-side source mutators in the primary developer checkout and accumulated generated changes beside live work. The plist was unloaded and archived; deploy/com.ruvnet.brain-nightly.plist was removed. Author rebuilds are now explicit clean linked-worktree operations. End-user cache freshness remains com.ruvnet.brain-update; Dream Machine remains the non-promoting evaluation schedule.

_retired.label: io.ruv.auto-subscribe
_retired.why: archived as cruft (archive-cruft-2026-07-14/); hourly RuvNet package auto-install is superseded by com.stuartkerr.ruflo-autoupdate (daily) + com.cognitum.ruvector-autoupdate. Removed from watch registry 2026-07-18 so nightly-watchdog stops flagging a deliberately-killed job.

_retired.label: com.ruvnet.npx-72h-verdict
_retired.why: A one-shot 72-hour verdict job: its script boots itself out after reporting, and its receipt sat at "running" from 2026-10-17. Its plist is no longer in ~/Library/LaunchAgents. Retired so a finished one-shot job is never read as a stuck one.

_retired.label: com.ruvnet.brain-gists
_retired.why: The local re-embed wrote the developer checkout's kb/ruv-gists.big.rvf, which no installed brain reads (installed brains get fresh gists from the nightly cloud corpus). Measured: 6-10 minute batches against a 15 minute stall watcher, runs killed on a loaded machine, and no consumer of the result. The plist was unloaded and archived on the owner Mac. scripts/nightly-gists.sh stays for a manual run.

_maxRunHours_note: maxRunHours (4.7.21): a receipt still 'running' past this many hours with a LIVE wrapper pid is STUCK (nightly-watchdog judge()); a gone pid is FAILING. job-heartbeat.sh stops a job at JOB_MAX_SECONDS (default 2 h), so 1 h is a warning before that kill for the short jobs.
